name: SaaS Alliance

sources.title: Homepage — SaaS professional community (The Alliance network / futureofsaas.io); membership, articles, podcasts
Create & Contribute — write-for-us rules (800+ words, no product promotion), podcast/event/report contribution routes

requirements: This is NOT a product listing directory — the free route is contributing non-promotional content (articles ≥800 words), podcast guesting, event speaking, or report contributions
'Individual contributions shouldn't promote your company's products or services. For that sort of stuff, we have sponsorship opportunities' — product marketing is paid sponsorship only
Contributor needs: royalty-free images, a profile photo, ≤200-char bio
Content topics: SaaS marketing, customer advocacy, growth, metrics, onboarding, GTM, SaaS+AI
preparation: A subject pitch (step 1 is submitting your topic BEFORE writing)
An ≥800-word article draft once the topic is accepted, with royalty-free images
Headshot + ≤200-char bio for the contributor profile
Author contact: email Anthony (anthony@futureofsaas.io) or Sophie — or Slack if already in the community
workflow: Email the subject pitch before writing
After acceptance, send the article link/attachment with profile pic + bio
Republished-elsewhere pieces are accepted via custom canonical links
For direct product exposure, the only routes are paid sponsorship (events, articles, reports, podcasts, webinars) via /partner/
watchFor: Do not pitch a product listing — there is no directory; pitching your product in an article violates their rules
Syndication policy: they may reuse contributed content across social/media
Many articles are members-only gated — exposure is to the 6k-member community, not open web
Site is part of The Alliance; contact emails live on futureofsaas.io / pmmalliance.com domains
countsAsLive: Your article appears under /articles or the blog feed with a bylined contributor profile (or your name in a podcast/report credit)
unknowns: Whether contributor articles can include a contextual link back to the author's product (link policy allows relevant contextual links, but promotion is barred)
